environment.browser: Chromium through Playwright in local container
environment.backend: Actual AssemblyScript/WASM in dedicated browser and Node workers

sources: isolated layer branch with world transforms/ancestor appearance
contract.colorModel: Per-channel encoded RGB seed mean, tolerance plus twice population standard deviation; visible painted pixels are forced seeds
contract.edge: Maximum adjacent encoded RGB component jump <= edgeThreshold
contract.alpha: Transparent barriers; selected coverage retains native source alpha
contract.brushPreview: Transient positive seed marks, not a grown-mask preview

memory.note: Global connectivity retains native RGBA and byte state planes, plus actual seed spans/frontier/output. Browser capture, source decoding, retained RLE, validation and history add memory. The WASM maximum and actual memory availability limit this operation, not document import size.

captureResponsiveness.yield: Task boundary between source tiles after about 8ms of work; recheck cancellation/ownership after resumption
captureResponsiveness.measurement: A queued zero-delay callback invokes the actual Hand toolbar control after the first captured tile. The tightened test verifies its pressed state before the first source-capture completion and response <250ms.
captureResponsiveness.caveat: Individual observations, not gesture p95, OS pointer-to-photon timing, a controlled multi-trial benchmark or cross-device responsiveness. The baseline phase flags were overwritten at duplicate progress values; only baseline elapsed/input timing and long-task entries are retained. Long tasks overlapping the operation include other browser work and may begin before its start.

fixture.description: Actual PNG with red/blue native components, distant regions and a diagonally touching island; four-connectivity excludes the disconnected island.

validation.build: npm run build passed, including WASM, isolated runtime, developer docs, TypeScript and Vite
validation.independentKernelOracle: Pixel-queue traversal compared with actual native scanline output across nine color/edge settings, including partial alpha and multiple seeds
validation.initialRestrictedUnitRun: 765 pass, 48 skip, five suite failures due to local-port EPERM; complete authorized rerun passed all 813
